text:
Priya: Quick async status on SOC2 audit logs and KMS/HSM proof — short version: app-level ingestion done, audit-backfill needed, KMS/HSM attestation + rotation artifacts outstanding. Asks: 1) SRE confirm safe backfill window for prod audit topic, 2) Eng-Infra confirm KMS key policy export + attestation artifacts, 3) Security (me) will assemble evidence by 2026-04-15.

Ethan: tagging in owners — Jorge for SRE/backfill, Maya for Eng-Infra/KMS work, Priya will own evidence packet.

Jorge: I can take SRE owner. Backfill window candidate: 2026-04-09 01:00-05:00 UTC (low traffic). Need schema compatibility check first. I'll draft a runbook and schedule a dry-run.

Maya: I opened PR #4821 for KMS key policy export + test harness. It includes an export script and sample metadata. @Ethan can you skim for secrets exposure? Also HSM vendor asked for nonce proof during attestation.

Ethan: I'll review #4821 by EOD. One blocker: the runbooks need a service account that can call `hsm:ListCertificates` and `kms:ListKeys`. Can DevOps create creds for `audit-ingest-sa` with read-only perms?

DevOps Bot: Created jira ENGOPS-789: "create audit-ingest-sa service account + grant list permissions" — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENGOPS-789 :white_check_mark:

Priya: For evidence we need: signed vendor attestation, exported KMS key metadata (fingerprints + rotation history), and a recorded rotation run (screenshot or video). I uploaded the checklist & template to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/soc2-audit-log-checklist (docs).

Jorge: Backfill gist with plan: replay consumer -> `audit-archive` -> `audit-logs-prod`. Command sketch:
```bash
python tools/replay_audit.py --from-topic audit-archive --to-topic audit-logs-prod --dry-run
```
I'll coordinate offsets with infra. Need a quick schema mapper if events are v2.

Ethan: heads-up: embedding-service emits v2 events with different field `user_id`->`uid`. I'll open PR for mapper: #4830 (mapper + test). If mapper isn't merged, backfill will produce schema errors.

Priya: Action items recap:
- Jorge: finalize backfill runbook, schedule dry-run, confirm offsets.
- Maya: get #4821 merged and run harness in staging, provide key export.
- Ethan: review #4821, open/land mapper #4830.
- DevOps: ENGOPS-789 creds + ETA.
Security: assemble evidence packet by 2026-04-15 and post in this thread when ready.

Maya: :thumbsup: Will merge #4821 after Ethan's review. Note: vendor also needs proof-of-rotation nonce; Priya can you confirm required format so we can add to harness?

Priya: I'll post the nonce format in this thread by EOD. Example export command for KMS metadata is in the doc, snippet below:
```bash
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/audit-key --output json > kms-rotation.json
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/audit-key --output json > kms-key.json
```
These outputs are acceptable artifacts for the auditor.

SREBot: Reminder: maintenance blackout window 2026-04-09 00:00-06:00 UTC (planned). Please align backfill to avoid the blackout.

Ethan: noted. If anyone hits a blocker on timelines speak up now. If we need to push evidence handoff, prefer pushing to 2026-04-17 rather than scramble.

Priya: thanks all. I'll ping reminder 48h before the target handoff and post a final evidence checklist. If you take an action item above, please reply with a quick ack. :eyes:
